notes.title: 【New General Preview】Shu·Liu Shan is about to make an appearance
notes.notes:
Dear Lords,
"Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals"will launch a new general [Shu] Liu Shan on April 24, 2024. What is his strength like? Lords, come and find out!

[b]Recruit opening time: April 24, 2024, 00:00 - April 30, 2024, 23:59 (GMT+8)[/b]

Introduction of Generals
*[Shu]Liu Shan
Liu Shan doesn't stand out in any of the three attributes, but his combined levels of command and intelligence among the four defensive generals reach a middle standard, granting him a certain level of survivability. Coupled with his own skill effects, as long as Liu Shan's health is maintained, he should be able to make a significant contribution on the battlefield through his healing abilities.

If you encounter any event-related issues during the event, contact us through customer service email: [b]Qimousg01@hotmail.com[/b].

notes.title: 【New General Preview】Wei·Jia Xu is about to make an appearance
notes.notes:
Dear Generals,
"Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals"[Wei] Jia Xu will make his debut on March 23, 2024. How will the calculating and resourceful Jia Xu perform in the game? His addition is sure to bring new dynamics to the battlefield!

[b]Recruit opening time: March 23, 2024, 00:00 - March 29, 2024, 23:59 (GMT+8)[/b]

Introduction of Generals
*[Wei]Jia Xu
The 7C general Wei Jia Xu possesses a base intelligence of 98 and an intelligence growth rate of 2.93 in his five-dimensional attributes. His overall intelligence is second only to Zhuge Liang, requiring only a small amount of additional points in the area of initiative, and can reach a threshold of 250 at full level. The skill effect "Conspiracy" not only provides a certain control effect but also has a very high damage multiplier. Additionally, the added accuracy can effectively prevent output from being evaded.

If you encounter any event-related issues during the event, contact us through customer service email: [b]Qimousg01@hotmail.com[/b].

notes.title: New Generals Limited-Time Recruitment
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Generals,[/b]
    ”Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals” [Han] faction will welcome two new generals on February 24, 2024. They are Han·Ma Dai and Han·Pang De.Let's take a look at how they will perform in the battle!

[b]Recruit opening time: February 24, 2024, 00:00 - March 1, 2024, 23:59 (GMT+8)[/b]

[b]Introduction of Generals[/b]
*[Han]Ma Dai
    The attribute panel of 3C Cavalryman Han·Ma Dai is not outstanding, but once his “LDR” is maxed out, it breaks through the 300 mark. Combined with the skill,which leverages the troop damage based on the difference in command and the skill's additional effects to enhance our side's survivability, he can perform quite well within the right system.

*[Han]Pang De
    The skill of 5C Cavalry Han·Pang De, besides causing high-frequency troop damage, also has the effect of destroying enemy buffs. It has a good restraining effect on some teams that rely heavily on buffs.

    If you encounter any event-related issues during the event, contact us through customer service email: [b]Qimousg01@hotmail.com[/b].

Event Period: December 30, 2023, 00:00 - January 5, 2024, 23:59 (GMT+8)
The stirring of the seven serpents shakes the world, and Zhao Yun of 7C Generals makes his debut. notes.title: [Game Launch Announcement] "Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals" OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
After several iterations, "Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals" has finally met everyone on the Steam platform. As a war strategy game based on the history of the Three Kingdoms, we always hope to lead all players, personally push the gears of history, step into the ancient battlefield of the Three Kingdoms in the chaos of war and smoke, and write their own history. The game mode adopts the season reincarnation mechanism, players can choose different historical stage scripts, and experience the real process of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. To celebrate the launch of the game, we have also prepared a launch gift package for everyone.

[b]Gift exchange code: QMSG8888
Gift content: Talent Recruitment*10, Coin*20000, Strategy Points*8000
Gift code redemption method: Click on the avatar in the upper left corner of the main game interface - click on "Code Redemption" in the upper right corner - enter the gift code to redeem the gift package[/b]

Finally, we look forward to your comments after you have played the game for a while, each comment can help us do better. If you encounter any game-related issues, you can contact us via the customer service email [b]Qimousg01@hotmail.com[/b].
